description: This Java source file defines the SourceGenerator class, which generates Java stub source code for filtered classes based on ASM bytecode reading and filtering logic. It includes methods for converting class names to file paths, creating writers for output files, and processing class data to produce source code.

classes.name: SourceGenerator
classes.description: A helper class for generating Java source code from bytecode ClassReader objects, filtering out private members, and writing stub files.

methods.name: generateSource
methods.description: Generates Java source files for a set of classes, writing them to a specified base directory after filtering.

methods.name: createWriter
methods.description: Creates a FileWriter for the given class output path, ensuring directories exist.

methods.name: classNameToJavaPath
methods.description: Converts a fully qualified class name to a Java source file path, e.g., android.view.View -> android/view/View.java.

methods.name: visitClassSource
methods.description: Processes a ClassReader object and writes out the corresponding source code, applying filtering to exclude certain members.
